enchantments.tooltip: Deadly +7: +7 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Accuracy +14: Passive: +14 Competence bonus to attack rolls
Armor-Piercing 14%: Passive: +14% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Seeker +9: Provides a +9 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +9 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Lost Purpose: This item is missing some parts that made it unique. Perhaps you can fix that at a Cannith Repurposing Station.
Mythic Head Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
